sentence_stem: The comic strip was very funny, so
correct_completion: everyone in the class wanted to read it again.
full_sentence: The comic strip was very funny, so everyone in the class wanted to read it again.
acceptable_variants: the students laughed for a long time.
many children asked for a copy.

options.text: everyone in the class wanted to read it again.
the drawings were in black and white.
options.why_wrong: This describes the drawings, but it does not give a result of the comic being funny.

options.text: nobody in the class wanted to look at it.
options.why_wrong: This is the opposite of the result that 'so' introduces after a funny comic.
This is unrelated to the comic strip and does not follow from it being funny.

explanation: After 'so', we need a clause that shows the result of the first part of the sentence. A very funny comic leads to people wanting to read it again.
translation: Комікс був дуже смішним, тому всі в класі хотіли прочитати його ще раз.
